help.stdout:
delivery-os — Spec-driven delivery tooling

Usage:
  delivery-os <command> [options]

Options:
  --help  Show root help
  --version  Show version and build identity
  --json  Emit the machine envelope instead of the human report
  --verbose  Add diagnostic detail to human output
  --pretty  Indent machine output

Examples:
  delivery-os --help
  delivery-os --version
  delivery-os status --json

Exit codes:
  0  The operation completed and returned its declared verdict
  1  The request was refused, invalid, or returned a negative verdict
  2  A platform, state, or provider failure prevented the operation

See also:
  doc/planning/oss-tooling/milestones/m1/man-page.md
  doc/planning/oss-tooling/milestones/m1/commands/entrypoint.md

Commands:
  status  Collect the nine-section delivery digest
  brief  Render the owner-facing delivery brief
  queue  Read and mutate the scheduling queue
  lanes  Read lane occupancy and economics
  blockers  Publish, list, and answer typed questions
  phase  Read and write lifecycle phase state
  commit  Create one commit through the commit primitive
  lint  Check pm-notes and plan conformance
  plan  Validate and compare delivery plans
  verify  Verify artifact, gate, and deploy evidence
  merge  Merge a verified ready item
  closeout  Plan or apply the post-merge sweep
  dispatch  Run one typed dispatch, read dual-run evidence, or move authority
  spend  Report captured spend and amplification
  retro  Collect and report retro evidence
  daemon  Run and manage the resident daemon: start, stop, status, install, uninstall
  coordinator  Supervise the coordinator session: start, stop, status, tick
  projects  Project groups: the declared repositories and their aggregate health
  repos  The flat record set of delivery-managed checkouts on the host
  events  Read the subscribe event taxonomy: list topics and describe one
